---
title: "Options"
---

## At a glance

| Option | Where | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `eval` | cell, document | `true` | Run the cell. |
| `echo` | cell, document | `true` | Show the source. |
| `output` | cell, document | `true` | Show the output; `asis` inserts printed text as markdown. |
| `error` | cell, document | `false` | Render exceptions instead of stopping. |
| `warning` | cell, document | `true` | Show what the cell wrote to stderr. |
| `include` | cell, document | `true` | `false` runs the cell but drops it from the output. |
| `latex` | cell, document | `true` | Show values as maths; `false` shows plain text. |
| `classes` | cell | — | Extra CSS classes for the code block. |
| `filename` | cell | — | Filename label above the code block. |
| `label` | cell | — | Cell label; `fig-…` makes the first figure cross-referenceable. |
| `fig-cap` | cell | — | Figure caption. |
| `fig-alt` | cell | — | Alternative text of a figure. |
| `fig-width` | cell | — | Width of a figure. |
| `python` | document | see below | A Python that can `import er2`. |
| `timeout` | document | `300` | Seconds before the render gives up. |
| `highlight` | document | `true` | Inject the ER2 syntax definition. |
| `prelude` | document | — | ER2 code run once, before the first cell. |
| `fig-format` | document | by format | `svg`, `png` or `pdf`. |
| `fig-dpi` | document | `96` | Resolution of bitmap figures. |

Cell options are `#|` comments at the top of a cell. Document options go
under `er2:` in the front matter, and the cell options given there are the
defaults for every cell.

```yaml
---
engine: er2
er2:
  python: /path/to/python
  timeout: 300
  prelude: |
    sym x, y
  echo: true
  error: false
---
```

## `echo`, `output`, `include`

```{er2}
#| echo: false
print("this cell's source is hidden")
```

```{er2}
#| output: false
print("this output is hidden")
```

## `output: asis`

What the cell prints is inserted as markdown, so a cell can write the
document:

```{er2}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
for n in (5, 7, 11):
    print(f"- $2^{{{n}}} - 1 = {2^n - 1}$, prime: {isprime(2^n - 1)}")
```

## `error`

By default an exception stops the render, reporting the cell and the ER2
traceback: a document that is supposed to be correct should not quietly
publish an error. When the error is the point, ask for it:

```{er2}
#| error: true
1/0
```

The session survives either way; later cells still run. Warnings are not
errors — they go to stderr, are shown, and never stop a render
(`warning: false` hides them).

## `latex`

```{er2}
sym x
(x + 1)^2 / 2
```

```{er2}
#| latex: false
(x + 1)^2 / 2
```

## `prelude`

ER2 code run before the first cell, for instance to declare the symbols
every cell uses. An error in the prelude stops the render.

## `python`

Without it the engine uses `ER2_PYTHON`, then the Python behind the `er2`
command on `PATH`, then `python3`. See
[Get started](getting-started.qmd#how-the-engine-finds-er2).
